name: EPIC 211559240
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 18, 5.8 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 990 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 18, give 0.88 solar masses and 5.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,811 K at its surface.
